ENHYPEN How ENHYPEN Turned Desire Into Pop Mythology ENHYPEN are a South Korean boy band formed through the 2020 television competition I-LAND and managed by BELIFT LAB. As of July 2026, the group has six members: Jungwon, Jay, Jake, Sunghoon, Sunoo and Ni-Ki. They debuted as a seven-member act in November 2020, but Heeseung left in March 2026 to pursue a solo career under the name Evan. 25 pages
